question: Does a chat unit learned from the parent's own verified replies, with a check_text tool, raise chat to its minimum on new wording, where the parent alone with a calculator failed on confirmation5?
why: confirmation5: documents and not-found passed; chat 86/96 failed by one case. Exclude scored 6/12 and has failed in every split; the chat route never had a check of its own or a learned unit. Two changes. (1) chat-tools/1: check_text lets the model check a draft against the rules it reads in the request (include, exclude, ending, word limit, bullets, JSON keys, lowercase) and revise; the scorer and the hidden constraints are unchanged. (2) C1, a low-rank chat unit on the parent, learned from the parent's own replies that pass the checker, rejection-sampled (greedy, then up to three samples at temperature 0.8) on generated-train and generated-train-styles2 (every spent wording). No other model writes an assistant message. Documents stay on L7 under version 2, which matched or beat L8 on confirmation5.

unit.name: C1
unit.layers: A2 layers and projections, rank and alpha

experience.chat: the parent's first passing reply under chat-tools/1 on the 320 generated-train and 240 generated-train-styles2 chat cases
experience.replay: the parent's greedy passing replies under chat-tools/1 on the 320 generated-train chat cases

training.rule: A2 trainer settings for the low-rank module; terminal step only; no checkpoint selection.

integration: parent and parent+C1 greedily on the 48 chat generated-development4 cases on the same GPU, both under chat-tools/1
next_gate: C1 advances to the sealed confirmation6 (with L7 for documents under version 2) only if, on generated-development4, it solves more chat cases than the parent under the same policy and at least 90% of them; documents are judged on confirmation6 only.
